'''R2-B3'''<ref name="Getty">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess#!asset/f6nfm5n469c8xp9sssh9p43|text=The Walt Disney Studios All Access - JTF-FF-001917|date=2022-06-13}}</ref> was a [[droid]] that was part of the [[Hidden Path]].<ref name="Kenobi" /> In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{KenobiDate|IV}}</ref> R2-B3 was present for a meeting preparing for the [[Rescue of Princess Leia (9 BBY)|Rescue of Princess Leia]].<ref name="Kenobi" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
R2-B3 appeared in "[[Part IV]]," the fourth episode of ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''.<ref name="Kenobi" /> It was first identified in promotional images released by [[The Walt Disney Company]] on [[Wikipedia:Getty Images|Getty Images]].<ref name="Getty" /> The droid shares its name with another from the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[R2-B3 (Jaina Solo)|R2-B3]], a droid owned by [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] that first appeared in ''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''.<ref name="NJO">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref>
